description: This file contains controller functions for handling chat message operations in a server-side application, including creating, retrieving, deleting, and aborting chat messages, as well as parsing API responses.

methods.name: getFeedbackTypeFilters
methods.description: Processes feedback type filters, returning a filtered array or undefined.

methods.name: createChatMessage
methods.description: Handles creation of a new chat message via chatMessagesService.

methods.name: getAllChatMessages
methods.description: Retrieves all chat messages based on query parameters.

methods.name: getAllInternalChatMessages
methods.description: Retrieves internal chat messages with specific filtering.

methods.name: removeAllChatMessages
methods.description: Removes all chat messages matching criteria, with optional session memory clearing.

methods.name: parseAPIResponse
methods.description: Parses and converts JSON string fields in chat message responses to objects.
